method: Instruction listings decoded directly from the PE bytes of the identified executable through its section table, with the executable size and SHA-256 verified first. Every cited locator address was checked to begin an instruction of its decoded function, and the operands, name literals, vftable cells, constants and call targets named in the claims were compared with those listings by a second pass. Callers were enumerated by scanning the .text section for rel32 call and jmp instructions and the whole image for dword references, so virtual and indirect callers are not covered. Addresses are absolute virtual addresses. The results of the constant switches were obtained by evaluating the functions with an interpreter that executes only compare, add, subtract, negate, subtract with borrow, and, move, zero extend and jump instructions, and the facts record counts and shapes, not the tables. The MEASURED facts are call-site counts that agree with xivl-client-scripts:lua/napi_index.json. Script argument counts, result counts and descriptor constants come from a local Lua 5.1 bytecode scan of the installed client scripts, decoded with tools/decode_lpb.py, that no tracked artifact carries, and are INFERRED. No decompiled body is a tracked evidence dependency.
scope: Static Lua call contracts of six WidgetBase natives: the list natives _addList, _removeList, _clearAllList and _getListProperty that drive the Sqwt data control model of the stub overload record, and the keyboard focus natives _isKeyboardFocused and _getKeyboardFocusedControl. Each row gives the registration site, the declared lists, the property writes or reads, the branches and the failure behavior. Client-side contracts do not establish form markup, list content or focus handling beyond the compared pointers.
evidenceTier: MIXED, see tierVocabulary and the tier of each fact

The script widget/widgetbaseclass_u contains the string constants _getListProperty_inl and _getListProperty_cpp, the descriptor name and its key. That the descriptor declares this native follows the binding map contract and is INFERRED.
The callback loads the address of its ExecuteParameters argument into ECX and jumps to 0x006EADA0, a routine of the same shape as 0x006EB070.

0x006EADA0 reads cell 0 and cell 2 through 0x0071CE70 and cell 1 through 0x005819A0. It resolves the widget handle through 0x0075BB60 and writes Index through 0x0075BB80, AttributeName from the literal at 0x00FD4D1C and ValueType from the literal at 0x00FD4D30 with the static text at 0x0134B898. It then builds a processor object of the RTTI class s_GetListPropertyProcessor with the vftable 0x00FD56F4 and reads the property named by the literal StringValue at 0x00FD4D50 through 0x0075BB90.

The processor vftable has the value handlers 0x00776340 (a bare return) in slots 1, 2 and 4, 0x00749400 in slot 3 and 0x00712B40 in slot 5. Only the string handler 0x00749400 pushes. It tests the first byte for empty text, compares the text with the literals True and False through 0x00445D60, tests numeric text through 0x004553A0 and parses it through 0x004555A0 with the base 10, and sets the done byte at processor +0x08.
That a Boolean attribute written by _setListProperty reaches Lua as a bool, a numeric attribute as an int and any other attribute as a string follows from the shared text forms of the two natives.
Which list names and attributes the form markup declares was not read. The result for a control that does not answer, and whether the processor then pushes nothing, were not traced.
The only script site is the wrapper in widget/widgetbaseclass_common at line 3117, a tail call that forwards every result.

The script widget/widgetbaseclass_u contains the string constants _getKeyboardFocusedControl_inl and _getKeyboardFocusedControl_cpp, the descriptor name and its key. That the descriptor declares this native follows the binding map contract and is INFERRED.
The callback jumps through offset 0x8C. The WidgetBase cell 0x00FD5B00 holds 0x006E3890 and the DesktopWidget cell 0x00FD5C18 holds 0x006DCAE0.

The WidgetBase routine builds a sink object with the vftable 0x00FD5784 over the result list through 0x00717460, reads Y through 0x00CC7510 and calls 0x0075B9A0 with the identity and the sink. 0x0075B9A0 resolves the widget through 0x004D9910 and calls 0x00535A90.

0x00535A90 loads the holder at 0x01356FCC and, when it is null, calls sink slot 1. Otherwise it takes the dword at holder +0x64, casts it to the framework type and obtains a container index through 0x00535780, or -1 for a failed cast. An index equal to the dword at widget +0x98 calls sink slot 2 with the name that the element vftable slot 2 returns. An index above 0 calls 0x00535450 and sink slot 3. Any other index calls sink slot 1.

The sink slot 1 routine 0x00749710 pushes nil twice through 0x00748920. Slot 2, 0x00749740, pushes nil and then a string through 0x007487C0. Slot 3, 0x00749770, pushes its first string argument and then its second through 0x007487C0.

In the third case 0x00535A90 calls the element vftable slot 2 for the element name and pushes it, calls 0x00535450 with the container index and pushes the string it returns, then calls sink slot 3. The last push is the first argument, so the container name comes first and the element name second. 0x00535450 searches the map at widget +0xEC for the index and returns the key at node +0xC, or the empty string at 0x01266B10. This is the argument order of _isKeyboardFocused.

Three script sites: commanddebugger/commanddebuggerdev at line 9424, widget/journallistwidget at line 284 and the wrapper in widget/widgetbaseclass_common at line 2949. The two non-debug sites take two results.
That the two strings are a container name and a control name that _setKeyboardFocusedControl accepts follows from the matching argument pair of that native.

hostContract.note: Values that a host must return for the rows to match the client.
rows: _addList, _removeList and _clearAllList edit the row set of the named list control and push nothing.
_getListProperty reads the attribute text of a row and pushes false for False, true for True, 0 for empty text, an int for decimal text and the text otherwise.
_isKeyboardFocused pushes true for the control that holds the focus and also for an unresolved name while nothing holds the focus.
_getKeyboardFocusedControl pushes nil and nil without focus, nil and the element name in the container of the receiver, and the container name followed by the element name for another container.
